tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ja)༄༅/ /khro bo rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa gtsang byed tshangs pa'i zla shel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /chag lo gsum pa'i gas
(ja)༄༅/ /khro bo rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa gtsang byed tshangs pa'i zla shel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /chag lo gsum pa'i gas

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// khro bo rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa gtsang byed tshangs pa'i zla shel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// chag lo gsum pa'i gsung*// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bai ḍūr lhun po ltar brjid khro bo'i rgyal// gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od 'phro bas// rnam rtog grib kyi tshang tshing sreg mdzad pa// sme brtsegs lhag pa'i lha yis srid 'di srungs// 'dir bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i man ngag 'di la don gsum ste/ yid ches pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ sgrub thabs dngos dang*/ las tshogs so// dang po ni/ khro bo 'chol pa nyid kyi jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la gnang*/ des nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba la gnang*/ de nas rim par lag sor ba/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ zul phu'i mkhan chen chos dbang*/ mkhan chen chos byang*/ mkhan chen chos kyi shes rab/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ gnyal gung snang ba/ bcom ldan lho mdzes pa/ rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/ chos rje ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la gnang ngo*// yang na/ lo mchog pa/ mnyam med grags rgyal pa/ bla ma shākya ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ dpal grub pa'i dbang po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la rjes su gnang ba legs par stsal ba'o// ༈ /gnyis pa sgrub thabs dngos ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ swa bhā was stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus rang gi sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gsum phyag drug pa/

rtsa zhal ljang sngon/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul sngon po'i thod bcings pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis sdigs mdzub thugs kar bsnol ba/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi se ral kha byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de dag gi zhal nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ sku snang la ma nges pa'i ngang la ci gnas su 'jog de las skyo na/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon gyi mthar/ sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas skor du bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus rang dang dmigs yul gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs rnams sku dang 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas par bsams la/

oṃ bhūrkuṃ ma hā prā rṇā ye bhūrtsi bhūrki bi ma na se u tsuṣma ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa snying po ste/ 'phral du brgya rtsa bzlas pas gang 'dod pa'i las rnams 'grub ste/ gong bsnyen bya mi dgos gsungs/ bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi nang skor du/ nye snying gis bskor ba dmigs la/ oṃ bhūr kuṃ gṛhṇa swā hā/ zhes pa nye snying ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig song na dga'/ med kyang chog gsungs/ 'di la rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba med par byams snying rje dang ldan pas 'gro ba la phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa gal che/ 'di gtsang sbra chung bas kyang 'grub bo// thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ bzod gsol/ mthar 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs nas 'god par shog ces bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong na/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsgyur/ skad cig gis khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gtor ma gsol bar bsams la snying po'i mthar ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags la dbul/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ zhal gsum phyag drug dbus ljang g.yas dkar g.yon dmar spyan gsum sdang mig gzigs// khro gnyer mche gtsigs dbu skra gyen brdzes rin chen rgyan mdzes dar gyi stod g.yogs can// thugs kar sdigs mdzub rdo rje ral gri zhags pa lcags kyu stag gi sham thabs gsol// padma nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang me phung dbus na bzhugs la 'dud// ces pas bstod/ grib sel ba la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ ༈ /gsum pa las sbyor sum cu so gnyis kyi dang po nyams grib sel bar byed pa'i bum sgrub rgyas pa ni/ maṇḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu dgu dgod/ dbus su bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa gu gul gyis bdugs te chu gtsang me dang*/

sman lnga/ dri lnga/ 'bru lnga/ snying po lnga/ rin po che lnga rnams blug steng du kha rgyan gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa gzhag dkar gtor gsum bsham/ zan gyi mtheb kyu changs bu nyer gcig re gzhag bdag bskyed tshar nas bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las khro bo bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ de la oṃ badzra ma hā kro dhā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs mchod bstod byas la/ sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song ba khro bo'i thugs kar thim/ thugs rgyud bskul bas/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsgom zhing snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o// de nas mchod bstod bya/ nyams grib zhi bar gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma dang po yi dam dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong la dbul/ gsum pa lan chags dang bgegs la bsngo/ mthar khro bo nyid kyang bdud rtsir zhu ste bum pa gang bar bsam/ shin tu grib che ba la bsgrub bya chu gtsang mas bkrus pa'i chu dri ma can de logs shig tu bzhag la/ de nas bum pa'i chus bkru zhing*/ oṃ bhūr kuṃ ma hā prā ṇā ye bhūrtsi bhūrki bi ma na se u tsuṣma ma hā kro dhā hūm̐ phaṭa/ che ge mo'i nyams grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sde 'khrugs kyi grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ khrims nyams kyi grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dam nyams kyi grib thams cad= mnol gyi grib thams cad= yugs sa'i grib thams cad= mdze can gyi grib thams cad= ro bag gi grib thams cad= dme can gyi grib thams cad= gdon gyi grib thams cad= grogs kyi grib thams cad= gnas kyi grib thams cad= zas kyi grib thams cad shīntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkrus pas lus thams cad dkar sangs kyis dag par bsam/

de ni khrus kyis sbyang ba'o// de nas gtor mas sbyang ba la gnyis las/ zhi bas sbyang ba ni/ gong gi changs bu dang mtheb kyu sbrags la/ rin po che'i snod yangs par gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod la/ nad pa la phyir bskor zhing*/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ yam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ ram̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ bam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ lam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shuddhe shuddhe sa ma ya a a a swā hā/ zhes bzlas la nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du dri ma'i chu logs su bzhag pa der blug gtor ma de lam rgya gram mam mi dang ma 'phrad kyi bar du phyi mig mi blta bar bskyal lo// de ni zhi bas sbyang ba'o// drag pos sbyang ba ni/ nad pa'i mgo dang srin lag bzhi

rkang pa'i dang*/ skud pa nag pos bcings la/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ che ge mo'i sdig sgrib dang grib thams cad skud pa 'di la thim par gyur cig ces pa lan gsum gyis nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad skud pa la thim par bsams la/ snying po la/ e ho shuddhe sogs btags la lus ngag yid gsum la gnod byed gdon bgegs rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces drag tu bzla zhing*/ gris skud pa bcad de dum bu rnams gong gi gtor ma de'i nang du bskyur nas/ bum chus bkrus pa'i dri ma dang lhan cig lam rgya gram mam/ mi dang ma 'phrad bar bskyal lo// de ni drag pos sbyar ba'o// shul du gu gul gyis bdug khro bo'i sngags bzla zhing yungs kar gyis brab bo// de lta bu'i cho ga lan gsum mam/ lnga'am bdun byas na grib nad ji ltar thu yang sos par the tshom med do// gnyis pa 'phral du grib sel ba'i bum sgrub bsdus pa ni/ bdag bskyed dang ldan pas mdun du bum pa'i snod gtsang mar/ srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang ma la/ bum rdzas yod dam med kyang rung*/ chu de'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las snying po'i sngags ljang sngon gyis bskor bas khrig mer te gang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi sngags phreng la phog de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas snod gang bar bsams la/ snying po brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig bzla/ sngags mchil chu la btab pas bzla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas chu la thim par bsams la/ rang gzhan gyi khong du btang zhing khrus byas na grib dang mi gtsang ba gang gis kyang mi tshugs/

zas gos gnas grogs kyi nyams grib chen po'am/ khyad par rang gi dam tshig la skyon byung na sngags brgya rtsa phan bzlas na thub nges te gtsang sbra med pas kyang 'grub gsungs so// gsum pa sngags mchil gyis grib sel ba ni/ zas gos gnas grogs gdon sogs rnam rtog za ba dang*/ grib chen la longs spyad dgos pa byung na/ bdag bskyed dang ldan pas/ grib can de'i steng du ram̐ dmar po gcig bsam/ sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa'i mchil ma thu thu zhes gtor bas/ ram̐ las me 'bar bas de bsregs par bsam mo// nyes skyon gdon grib thams cad thub bo// bzhi pa lam du 'gro ba'i tshe grib gtor gyis grib sel ba ni/ zas kyi phud gcig dang lhag ma changs bu gcig la gtor ma bya/ bdag bskyed dang ldan pas khro bo'i sngags dang chos skyong gang yin gyi sngags brgya rtsa bzla/ gtor ma de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs la/ khro bo sme brtsegs dang chos skyong la phul la/ grib zhi ba'i phrin las bcol te gtor ma 'gro phyogs su gtong*/ lam du 'jug kar snying po bzla zhing dri chu'i sbyor ba bya/ grub na grib can mang po'i khrom mam/ gdon gnyen po chags pa'i sar blo rdeg gi grib sel bya/ ma grub kyang sngags bzlas pas grib thams cad srung zhing mi phog go /lnga pa dri chu'i sbyor bas grib sel ba ni/ dri chu bar pa khyor ba g.yon par blugs pa la/ snying po dang nye snying lan bdun bzlas te g.yas pa'i srin mdzub kyis dpral ba/ lce rtse/ snying gar thig le bya/ chu lhag ma sna bug g.yon par 'thung ba'am/ 'thung bar bsams la rgyab tu gtor bas nyams grib 'go nad bar chad thams cad thub bo// drug pa glo rdeg tu grib sel ba ni/ yul phyogs tsam la lung pa de'i chu mgo'am/ grong khyer tsam la yul de'i khron pa'am/ rdzing ngam/ chu mig gam/ khyim gcig la'ang rang rang gi chu ra'i nang*/ glo bur du dgos na chu gtsang ma'i snod du khro bo bskyed la/

rdo la khro bo'i sku brkos la chu ra'i nang su gzhug go/ sngags gang 'grub bzlas nas khro bo zhu ba'i chur bsams te/ 'thung ba dang khrus bya ba dang*/ khang khyim la sogs pa gang mi gtsang ba la gtor na grib gang yang mi 'byung ngo*// bdun pa glo rdeg tu smyo 'bog 'dul ba ni/ gu gul bsngags la bdug cing smyo 'bog gnod byed bar chad thams cad chom chom bsregs par bsams te snying gar sngags brgya rtsa brgyad gdab/ des 'tsho'o// brgyad pa yams nad srung ba ni/ seng ldeng phur pa sor bzhi pa bzhi'i mgul du yungs kar ras gtsang mar gtum pa btags te/ sngags bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir zug go /chu gtsang la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ nyi ma shar ma thag khang thog nas sngags bzla zhing phyogs bzhir 'thor na/ 'go ba'i yams nad sngar byung ba chad cing phyis mi 'ong zhing srung bar 'gyur ro// dgu pa rims nad srung ba ni/ bum pa spos chus bkang la yungs kar la sngags mang du bzlas la bum par blug des bu ga kun bkru zhing 'thung du gzhug mthil bzhi gdong dang lnga gu gul gyis bdug go /des phan no// bcu pa nad sna tshogs sel ba ni/ wa ba dang*/ gnyan dang*/ rma 'bras dang*/ phol mig dang*/ lhog pa dang*/ gzer nad mtha' dag la gu gul gyis bdug cing rtse gsum phyag rgya gtad/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis gzir/ sngags drag tu bzlas la btab pas phan no// nad pa'i sngas srung byed na mgar gyi so tshwa la bsngags la nad pa brab bo// bcu gcig pa gag pa sel ba ni/ 'di la phyir bcos pa dang nang du bcos pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phyi'i rma dang shu ba la snyad btags pa la rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya la sngags gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ smyug sbub nang nas kha ru gdab/ tshabs ches nas khrag don snod la bab na/ ga pur la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab pa gtong ngo*// des 'tsho'o// bcu gnyis pa gcong nad can gso ba ni/

shog bu la nad pa'i ming bris la/ gzugs la nad bdag bkug la bstim/ nad pa de nyid kyi mal 'og tu bcug nad pa la dmigs pas gzir te/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab na phan no// bcu gsum pa nad pa'i gdon zhud srung ba ni/ mgar ba'i so mal gyi tshwa tshwa'i lcags phye la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab la brabs pas thub bo// bcu bzhi pa klad gzer sel ba ni/ ga pur dang gu gul la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab nas khong du btang bas sos so// yang bal po se'u la sngags btab nas byin na sos so// bco lnga pa ling tog sel ba ni/ sngags bzlas pa'i phus sel lo// bcu drug pa chu 'gags sel ba ni/ mar dang gla rtsi la sngags bzlas nas byin pas 'phral du chu thon no// bcu bdun pa sbos pa sel ba ni/ tshwa dang dri chu la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab nas byin na sel lo// bco brgyad pa phyugs kyi god kha bzlog pa ni/ btsan dug dkar nag dmar gsum/ thar nu/ re lcag pa gsum gyi phye ma sbrus la gdon gzugs bya/ seng ldeng gi phur pa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa de'i snying gar btab nas gzir la phyogs gzhan du sba'o// sngags chu phyugs la gtor bas god kha chad do// bcu dgu pa zho nyes srung ba ni/ dug sna lnga'i liṅga la phur bu gdab/ chu gtsang la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te btab pas slar srung ngo*// nyi shu pa phyugs nad srung ba ni/ mtshan mo ra ba'i dbus su khri'i steng du bum pa spos chus bkang ba la sngags bzlas la btab pas/ rgyang ring po nas ra ba'i sa dang phyugs thams cad la khyab par gtor bas/ slar byung ba chad cing phyis 'byung ba srung ngo*// nyer gcig pa sre'u gso ba ni/ seng ldeng gi phur pa la sngags mang du bzlas pa btab nas sre'u la gdags/ dug sna lnga'i gdon gyi liṅga la sngags brdeg cing phur bus gdab bo// des sre'u la gdon gyis gnod pa mi nus so// nyer gnyis pa ra lug la spyang ki srung ba ni/

sngags dbu can bris la/ gang bsrung rnams kyi ske la btags nas srung nges so// nyer gsum pa bang mdzod du sris 'gong srung ba ni/ tsandan nam shug pa dkar po'i phur pa sor brgyad pa yang na sor bcu gnyis pa la dar nag gi cod pan gdags/ de khro bo sme brtsegs su bskyed/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab la/ thod pa mtshan ldan 'bru nag pos bkang ba la phur bu btsugs nas bang mdzod du bzhag na 'gong pos gnod par mi nus te sris sme'o// nyer bzhi pa khyi srung ba ni/ sbang zan la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab nas byin na khyi mi 'ong ngo*// nyer lnga pa klu'i gnod pa srung ba ni/ klu de'i rten chu mig gam/ bra ma la sogs pa yod pa'i sar thal ba gtsang ma la sngags sum stong btab nas mtha' bskor na klus gnod pa mi nus so// nyer drug pa chu mig gso ba ni/ sngar chu mig skye ba lha 'dres bkag pa sogs kyis skam na/ bag phye dang klu sman bsres/ glang bu che chung gnyis byas la sngags stong btab ste/ chu mig tu sbas na khab tsam skye zhing*/ yang yang bskyar na je cher 'gro'o// yang glang dmar gyi zal khrag dang chu mig gi chu bsre/ sngags btab la grod pa gcig bkang*/ glang dmar po gcig la bkal/ gcig khrid du gzhug la sgrub pa pos snyung bu'am khab grod pa la rgyab bo// sngags zlos shing ded pas khrag gang du zad pa'i sar chu skye'o// lar phan tshun du'ang skye'o// nyer bdun pa chu bsgyur ba ni/ yul zhing la chu zug na/ seng ldeng gi phur bu sor brgyad pa gcig la sngags stong btab ste chu snar btab pas chu de gzhan du 'gyur ro// nyer brgyad pa shwa 'od srung ba ni/ zhing la shwa 'od 'ong na zangs sam lcags la 'brug gi gzugs byas la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab la shwa snar bzhag na bzlog go /nyer dgu pa zhing la 'bu srung ba ni/ lan tshwa dang yungs kar bsres la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te zhing gi mthar bskor zhing rlung phyogs nas zhing la khyab par brabs pas gzhan du bros so// sum cu pa ser ba srung ba ni/

khro bo'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyis sprin dang ser ba bsregs par bsams te/ sprin la rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan/ thal chen dang yungs kar gyi thun la sngags zlos shing brdeg go /skabs su sngags kyi sham bur/ 'brug gi kha chings/ glog gi lce chod/ thog gyen la zlog sprin gyis gur shig ser ba'i rkang chog ces kyang btags te drag tu bzlas pas ser ba bzlog go /so gcig pa 'gong po nor phyugs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bsreg pa ni/ tsher ma can gyi shing gru gsum du brtsegs la me sbar/ de'i dbus su khro bo sme brtsegs bskyed/ dug sna lnga las byas pa'i gdon gyi liṅga la dgug gzhug byas/ gtubs pa'i dum bu khro bo'i zhal du dbul zhing*/ sngags sum brgya zlos pa grangs mnyam du bsregs na 'gong pos gnod par mi 'gyur ro// so gnyis pa byad bzlog pa ni/ rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis sngags bzlas pas sku las 'phros pas me'i phung pos snang srid gang*/ byad ma tshig par bsams la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i mthar/ thal mo gnam sa brdabs pa'i bar du byad ma brlags par bsams la thal mo brdabs pas bzlog par 'gyur ro// 'di ltar 'gro ba'i grib mun sel byed cing*// mi dbang mngon dgyes kunda rgyas slad du// sme brtsegs zhal gsum zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang*// skal bzang dwangs pa'i mkha' la deng 'dir shar// dge ba gur gum snye ma'i phreng*// legs bshad dri bsung kun dga'i skyes// lus can rkang drug tshogs rnams kun// rnam mkhyen sbrang rtsis tshim gyur cig /khro bo sme brtsegs kyi man ngag gi rim pa gtsang byed tshangs pa'i zla shel zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi mnga' bdag mi'i dbang po don yod rdo rje rgyal po'i bkas bskul ba'i bzhed pa bzhin/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos yar gsum lhun po rtse'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ//

༈ /sme brtsegs kyi gdams ngag dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi phyag len myang grub ma ni/ nor ram phyugs la 'gong po rjes su 'brangs nas gnod pa byas na/ drag po'i thab khung gi nang du tsher ma can gyi shing la me sbar/ me de bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khro bo chen po yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ 'gong po can gyi nor phyugs kyi bdag po de'i skra sen dang zas lhag gos kyi dri ma bsres pa'i liṅga la dgug gzhug yang yang bya/ mtshon gyis dum bur gtubs la/ sngags brgya rtsa tsam bzla zhing bsreg khro bo'i zhal du gsol bar bsams la gnod byed kyi ming nas brjod cing*/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod/ bsregs zin pa dang lha rang la bstim mo/ shu bhaṃ// ༈ /khro bo sme brtsegs kyi sngags don cung zad bshad pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo sme brtsegs 'di spyir khro bcu'i nang gi stobs po che yin/ de'i grib sel gyi sngags 'di/ rgya gar skad la ming tshang ba snga phyir bsgrigs pa tsam de ma yin par/ yi ge'i thog ma bsdus pa dang*/ thog mtha' bsdus pa shin tu mang bas go dka' ba yin/ dper na bod skad la'ang*/ blo gros grags pa blo grags zhes pa lta bu ming gi thog ma bsdus pa dang*/ chos ldan rab 'byor la chos 'byor zhes pa lta bu ming gi thog mtha' bsdus pa yin te/ de 'dra sngags 'di la'ang mang po yod pa lags so// de yang*/ oṃ nam mkha'/ bhūr sa 'og kuṃ sa steng rnams kyi ma hā chen po/ brā ṇa ye srog la/ bhūrtsi sa 'og gso ba/ bhūrki sa 'og chu/ bi mā na se gzhal med khang gi 'gro ba/ u tsuṣma 'chol bo/ ma hā kro dhā khro bo chen po/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ mkha'/ bhūr sa 'og kuṃ ri bden pa/ li sa steng la rol pa/ zhu legs/ tharsha mthong*/

hūr me'i 'khor lo/ shī zhi bar byed pa/ bi ma le dri ma med pa/ u tsuṣma 'chol ba'i sme brtsegs/ ma hā kro dhā khro bo chen po/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gnyis rtsa sngags yin no// de la bhūr khung zer ba ma dag bhūr kur zhes pa'ang gzhan 'ga' zhig la snang ste rung tsam yin/ de la oṃ ni bkra shis pa'i don mgo 'dren pa yin/ dngos su bsgyur rgyu med kyang nam mkha' la spyod pa'i sa bon yin/ bhūr zhes pa sa 'og tu spyod pa/ ku ni sa ste sa steng la spyod pa yin pas 'jig rten gsum mo// klad kor ni tshig phrad de/ mkha' spyod dang*/ sa 'og dang*/ sa steng rnams kyi zhes pa'i don go/ ma hā chen po/ prā ṇā ye/ srog la zhes pa ste/ mkha' spyod sa 'og sa steng thams cad kyi srog chen por zhugs pa'i don yin pas/ pra ma ṇa ye zer ba ma dag go /yang bhūr zhes pa sa 'og tsi zhes pa yi ge bsnan te/ ci kī ra sa zhes pa gso ba ste/ sa 'og gi klu dang*/ lha min sogs kyi nad dang sdug bsngal gso ba'o// yang bhūr ni sa 'og ki ni yi ge bsnan pas ki lā la te chu/ bi mā na se ni/ gzhal yas khang gi shing rtar zhugs pa ste/ sa 'og dang rgya mtsho la gzhal yas khang du zhugs nas/ khang bzang der 'gro ba'i don no// u tsuṣma ni 'chol ba ste/ gtsang btsog med pa'i don yin pas/ 'chol ba'i don la bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis sme brtsegs su 'gyur ba'o// ma hā kro dhā ni khro bo chen po'o// yang oṃ dang bhūr dang kuṃ rnams gong bzhin/ ri zhes pa la ta bsnan ste ri ta bden pa/ li zhes par la dang ta yig bsnan pas la li ta ste rol pa/ des na 'jig rten gsum la bden par rol pa'o// shu ni zur chag gi skad de/ legs sbyar ltar na/ su zhes pa nye bsgyur yin pas/ 'dir legs par bsgyur dgos la/ thar sha mthong ba ste/ legs par mthong ba'o// hūm̐ zhes pa la yi ge bsnan te/

hū ra zhes pa ni me yin la/ mtha' rten ra la hi ta zhes pa bsnan te ra hi ta g.yog po zhes pa yin pas/ me'i g.yog gam 'khor te/ me lha'i gdon/ rims bdag nad bdag thams cad do// shī zhes pa shī baṅka ra ste zhi bar byed pa zhes so// bi ma le zhes pa ni dri ma med pa'o// u tsuṣma ma hā kro dhā ni gong bzhin no// hūm̐ phaṭa ni drag po'i sngags kyis mtha' brten pa'o// des na oṃ mkha' dang*/ sa 'og dang*/ sa steng rnams kyi srog chen po'o// sa 'og gso la/ sa 'og gi chu la gzhal med khang pas bgrod pa'i 'chol ba'i khro bo chen po hūm̐ phaṭa/ nam mkha' dang*/ sa 'og dang*/ sa steng na bden pa la rol pa/ legs par mthong ba me'i 'khor zhi bar byed pa'i dri ma med pa/ 'chol ba'i khro bo chen po hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces par bsgyur dgos pa yin no// skad dod rgya skad gzhan rnams grags che la/ bhūr zhes pa sa 'og gi skad dod yin tshul ni/ bhūr bhū ba swa zhes pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla zhes par bsgyur ba bzhin yin cing*/ ku zhes pa sa la 'jug pa ni/ ku mud zhes pa sa dga' dang*/ ku ba la zhes pa sa stobs su bsgyur ba bzhin no// yang oṃ dang hūm̐ dang phaṭa la/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo sogs las bshad pa mang du mdzad yod kyang kun gyi thun mong du grags pa yin pas 'dir ma bris so// zhes pa'ang 'tsho byed dge slong legs pa dar rgyas kyis bskul nas kun dga' snying pos smras pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
